audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Kennen, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kennen, Kayle, Kayle. The packet chart reads Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Skill, Kayle — and the existing whys agree with the packet, not with the chart: whys[1] says his W marks you and your one Q point cannot punish, whys[2] says he zones your CS, whys[3] ends 'even', whys[4] 'coin-flip', whys[5] 'roughly even'.
audit.why: Rows 1-5 render a winner that the sentence underneath contradicts. Thundering Shuriken is 950 range on a 4s cooldown at max against melee autos until Divine Ascent's ranged tier, so Kennen owning levels 2-3 and the lane being a coin-flip through first item is what both the data and the prose already say.
audit.corrected: phases[1..5].side and win[1..5] set to Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Skill as five matched pairs. Row 0 (Kennen) and row 6 (Kayle) already agree everywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slicing Maelstrom is called a 'stun-channel' in five places, and mid says popping R makes 'the whole lockdown whiff against an immune target'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Slicing Maelstrom is a storm that repeatedly strikes nearby champions — there is no channel, and the stun comes from Mark of the Storm reaching 3 stacks, not from the ultimate itself. Divine Judgment's text grants invulnerability, which is damage immunity; whether it also prevents the Mark stun is not in Riot's text and I will not assert it either way. Telling a player the lockdown whiffs, when the storm's ticks may still be stacking Marks on them, sells a free escape that may not exist.
audit.corrected: Restated as: pop R and the storm's damage lands on an invulnerable target for zero. The CC claim is removed rather than reversed. Slicing Maelstrom's 120s cooldown added where it makes the bait concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither Divine Judgment's 160s nor Slicing Maelstrom's 120s appears anywhere, though 'track its cooldown' is the closing instruction of the late block.
audit.why: The whole level-6 plan is trading your 160s ultimate against his 120s ultimate. Without both numbers the player cannot tell that he gets a spare Maelstrom every other rotation at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 160s at rank 1 written into the level-6 spike; 120s written into the late block, spikes[3] and mid.

audit.why: 51.74% over 172 games supports the EVEN label; small sample, so I did not touch diffRating.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flags 'His Thundering Shuriken' and 'His Electrical Surge'.
audit.why: Both are the real ability names in the kit. False positives from the leading 'His'.

edits.before: Your R can eat his Slicing Maelstrom (R) stun-channel whole, but he out-pokes you between cooldowns, so the trade stays a coin-flip.
edits.after: Divine Judgment blanks Slicing Maelstrom's damage, but its ticks still stack Marks and he out-pokes you after — the trade stays a coin-flip.

edits.before: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE waves and Divine Judgment (R) grants invuln, so this is the first level you can farm safely and pop R to ride out his Slicing Maelstrom (R) stun-channel instead of getting locked down and bursted.
edits.after: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with AoE waves and Divine Judgment (R, 160s at rank 1) grants invuln, so this is the first level you can farm safely and pop R so his Slicing Maelstrom storm ticks for zero damage instead of bursting you.

edits.before: Your level-16 fully-ranged AoE waves plus E missing-health shred out-DPS a squishy Kennen in any extended fight. Bait his Slicing Maelstrom, pop R through the stun-channel, then keep autoing as the invuln drops and he melts.
edits.after: Your level-16 fully-ranged AoE waves plus E missing-health shred out-DPS a squishy Kennen in any extended fight. Bait Slicing Maelstrom (120s), pop R so the storm ticks for zero, then keep autoing as the invuln drops and he melts.

edits.before: Level 6 is your release valve, not a kill button. Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves so you can finally farm without walking into shuriken range, and your R (Divine Judgment) makes you invulnerable, so when he flashes in for the Slicing Maelstrom (R) stun-channel, pop your R and let the whole lockdown whiff against an immune target. Don't chase him afterward; he out-ranges your follow-up. Once Nashor's Tooth lands, your ranged autos plus E (Starfire Spellblade) missing-health on-hit start to genuinely hurt a squishy with no sustain, and the lane levels out around even.
edits.after: Level 6 is your release valve, not a kill button. Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves so you can finally farm without walking into shuriken range, and your R (Divine Judgment) makes you invulnerable, so when he flashes in for Slicing Maelstrom (120s), pop your R and every tick of the storm lands on an invulnerable target for zero damage. Don't chase him afterward; he out-ranges your follow-up. Once Nashor's Tooth lands, your ranged autos plus E (Starfire Spellblade) missing-health on-hit start to genuinely hurt a squishy with no sustain, and the lane levels out around even.

edits.before: This is where the EVEN lane tips your way. At 2+ items and especially level 16, every auto fires AoE waves and your E shreds by missing health, so a no-sustain Kennen simply cannot survive your sustained DPS once a fight goes long, and your R invuln answers the one thing he has: the Maelstrom stun-channel. Bait his R, pop yours through the lockdown, then keep autoing as the invuln drops and he melts. The only way he beats you now is catching you with a full Mark of the Storm stun chain while your R is down, so track its cooldown and never face-check him for it.
edits.after: This is where the EVEN lane tips your way. At 2+ items and especially level 16, every auto fires AoE waves and your E shreds by missing health, so a no-sustain Kennen simply cannot survive your sustained DPS once a fight goes long, and your R invuln answers the one thing he has: Slicing Maelstrom's damage. Bait his R, pop yours and the storm ticks for nothing, then keep autoing as the invuln drops and he melts. The only way he beats you now is catching you with a full Mark of the Storm stun chain while your R is down, so track its 120 seconds and never face-check him.

edits.before: Survive his Thundering Shuriken (Q) poke to level 6, then use Divine Judgment (R) invuln to ride out his Slicing Maelstrom stun-channel for free
edits.after: Survive his Thundering Shuriken (Q, 4s at max) poke to level 6, then use Divine Judgment invuln so Slicing Maelstrom's storm ticks for nothing
